name: @semiont/tests-conformance
description: Black-box conformance suites for the gateway, the dispatcher, the Archivist, the Worker service, the Weaver, the Smelter and the SDKs: they start the processes and check them against specs/. They import nothing from any implementation but the graph's reader, which the Weaver suite reads the graph with; what that suite does to the database itself it does in Cypher, and the Smelter suite reads and changes the vector index by its own calls to Qdrant. See README.md.

scripts.pretest: npm run typecheck:weaver && npm run typecheck:smelter
scripts.test:gateway: npm run typecheck && vitest run --project gateway
scripts.test:dispatcher: npm run typecheck && vitest run --project dispatcher
scripts.test:archivist: npm run typecheck && vitest run --project archivist
scripts.test:sdk: npm run typecheck && vitest run --project sdk
scripts.test:worker: npm run typecheck && vitest run --project worker
scripts.test:worker-service: npm run typecheck && vitest run --project worker-service
scripts.test:weaver: npm run typecheck:weaver && vitest run --project weaver
scripts.test:smelter: npm run typecheck:smelter && vitest run --project smelter
